inc-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT 7432101111 - streaming p99 spike detected on websocket-service. Paging rule triggered for /v1/stream and /v1/live. Severity: SEV2. @oncall-sre paged.

maya: on it — pulling traces + grafana panels now. link: https://grafana.internal/redwood/streams?from=now-30m

raghav: looking at proxy metrics: write_backpressure and send_queue_depth spike at ~T0+3m. p99 tail latency aligns with proxy write stalls.

lee: saw a CS ping from a customer reporting partial responses. @jordan can you confirm which customer and timeline?

jordan: CS confirms customer "BrightHealth" reported chunk drops and reconnects starting 12:14 UTC. excerpt from session log: `ws-session-id=abc123 status=partial_response proxy=502 at=2026-03-15T12:14:22Z`

miguel: prepping a quick rollback of proxy binary to v2.3.9 to rule out recent change. will start deploy in 30s and keep traffic on canary.

inc-bot: Oncall acknowledged by @oncall-sre. Activating runbook: streaming-tail (runbook #3). Please post mitigation progress.

oncall-sre: acknowledged. immediate actions: increase proxy write buffer to 8MB, enable aggressive keepalive, and throttle max-client-connections for the streaming pool. executing now.

miguel: rollback initiated (deploy-id=deploy-7823). applying config patch: ```proxy.max_write_buffers=8388608
proxy.keepalive_ms=30000```

raghav: traces show KV cache miss spike correlating with those times — clients are likely applying backpressure and causing long-lived write retries. also seeing elevated retransmits on connections.

ash: CS is on a call with BrightHealth. they've agreed to temporary client-side throttling for 15m if we need to run tests. no revenue outage reported yet but they're sensitive to >30m impact.

lee: mitigation checklist: 1) config bump (done), 2) rollback (in progress), 3) enable circuit-breaker for slow clients (pending). updating incident timeline.

miguel: rollback complete. Observability update: p95 returned to baseline within 2m of rollback, p99 improved ~40% but still above SLO by ~12%. continuing to watch for ~15m.

raghav: hypothesizing root cause: proxy writeback loop combined with OS send-buffer exhaustion under heavy fanout -> slow consumer amplification. recommend socket keepalive tweaks and backoff on long-TCP buffers. quick sysctl patch: ```sysctl -w net.core.wmem_max=8388608
sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_tw_reuse=1```

oncall-sre: customer impact note for postmortem: BrightHealth experienced ~18% chunk loss across ~2k websocket sessions between 12:14-12:28 UTC. filing incident report and scheduling RCA. handing off to eng-runtime for deeper root cause.

lee: :white_check_mark: Handoff done. @miguel @raghav please upload traces, stack dumps, and deploy diffs to the incident doc. we'll keep watch for 30m then decide on long-term fixes (socket-level guards, proxy backpressure mitigations, and client throttling guidance).

inc-bot: Incident status: Mitigation applied; monitoring. Next update due in 15m or on significant change.
